about: Nehemiah tells how God's people rebuilt the broken walls of Jerusalem together.

pages.title: Broken Walls
pages.scene: Nehemiah serving the king, looking sad
pages.text: Nehemiah worked for a king far away. He heard that Jerusalem's walls were broken down. He was very sad, so he prayed. Then he asked the king, "May I go and fix them?" The king said yes!
pages.lesson: Pray first, then do what's right.

pages.title: Everyone Helps
pages.scene: Families working together on the city wall
pages.text: Everyone helped build the wall: priests, families, even girls! Some enemies laughed and tried to stop them. Nehemiah said, "Our God will fight for us!" They kept working. In just fifty-two days, the wall was finished!
pages.lesson: We can do great things when we work together.

pages.title: Reading God's Book
pages.scene: Ezra reading on a tall wooden stage to the crowd
pages.text: All the people met in the square. Ezra read God's law from morning to noon. The helpers explained it so everyone understood. The people cried, but Nehemiah said, "Don't be sad! The joy of the Lord is your strength."
